_doc: Scripts a PR-triggered workflow runs that ci-local.sh deliberately does not. Each needs a reason a local checkout cannot satisfy. Verified by running each on 2026-11-02. scripts/ci-parity-contract.py fails on a stale entry.
evidence-audit.py: Rewrites EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md on every run (measured: 98-line diff on a clean tree); the workflow only regenerates a report, so a local run would dirty the tree without adding an assertion. Use `evidence-audit.py --summary` by hand.
omega-page-census.py: Creates config/omega-page-census.json on every run (measured: untracked file on a clean tree); a report generator, not an assertion.
integrate-spatial-realms.js: A materializer: the spatial-* workflows run it to rewrite files, then commit. Not a check.
tests/test_content_pipeline_e2e.py: Needs the `supabase` CLI and a database (FileNotFoundError: 'supabase' locally); runs in supabase-full-migration-replay.yml.
vercel-deployment-auth-check.sh: Needs a valid VERCEL_TOKEN secret (exits VERCEL_AUTH=FAIL without one); the deploy path is postponed anyway (see vercel-production.yml env).
vercel-production-smoke.sh: Fetches the live production site over the network; its result depends on what is deployed, not on the diff.
vercel-production-surface-smoke.py: Fetches the live production site over the network (64 s locally); depends on what is deployed, not on the diff.
